title: Quick Styles that remember your choices
summary: Choose a style family, repeat its last variation in one click, and manage saved styles directly from their tiles.

Added: Compact grouped Quick Styles for Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Circle / ellipse, Other shapes, Text / Monospace, Callout / Rounded Callout and currently supported straight arrows. Saved styles appear first.
Each category keeps its last variation across restarts. Its main preview repeats that choice; an enclosed triangle opens the variations.
Right-click a saved style to Update from selection or Delete style. Updating retains its name; neither action changes other document objects.
Presets and saved templates also set new-object formatting. Shape category changes preserve selected labels, bounds and identities with one Undo.
Verified: Native saved-style update/delete, repeated preset changes, saved-first ordering, active borders, and main-button repetition after process restart.
Editable shape conversion and new styled drawing preserve original image data; native clipboard output matches256000pixels.

limitations: Only implemented geometry is offered: Other contains the current polygon; callouts use the current box/tail geometry; curved arrows remain planned.
Complete core-tool options, Simplify, crisp vector zoom, editable autosave and toolbar ordering remain unfinished.
Snapping covers object/group movement and new Step placement. Drawing endpoints, resizing, grid and angle snapping remain pending.
